_cli_groups: Help groups for this package's commands that no Concept Model class names (group 4, 4.6): a `cli` entry may say which `group` it is listed under, and the group's one-line label is here. A registry-discovered class labels its own group with CONCEPT_LABEL.

cli_groups.correspondence: Cross-system conceptual mapping with evidence provenance and dispute tracking
cli_groups.synthesis: Qualitative analysis — sources, codes, themes, interpretations, claims, and reasoning threads
cli_groups.presentation: Slide/layout model — decks, frames, layout regions, and cross-universe content reference nodes
cli_groups.aggregation: Grouping and statistical summary — units, groups, measures, directed analysis, and hierarchies

_code_paths_seeds: app/seeds/<app>/ holds the first-run sample capsules `sys.onboarding.seed` plants (read through the app/config/seed/*.json recipes). The three app directories only — app/seeds/*.py at the top are dev generators and do not ship.

AKASHA_ANALYSIS_MAX_DISTINCT.means: distinct values a field may carry before the analysis names it high-cardinality

AKASHA_ANALYSIS_TOPN.means: rows of a count projection kept (the top N)

AKASHA_GROUPBY_MAX_SETS.means: sets a group-by projection may enumerate

AKASHA_PRECOMPUTE_CHUNK.means: members read per chunk by a precompute pass

AKASHA_PRECOMPUTE_MAX_FIELDS.means: fields a precompute pass scans per pool

AKASHA_PRECOMPUTE_MAX_MEMBERS.means: largest pool a precompute pass prepares; a larger one is reported, not scanned

AKASHA_PRECOMPUTE_MAX_PAIRS.means: field pairs a cross-tabulation precompute computes

AKASHA_PRECOMPUTE_SCATTER_PCAP.means: points kept in a precomputed scatter

AKASHA_PRECOMPUTE_YIELD_EVERY.means: members between two yields of a precompute pass (0 = never yield)

AKASHA_PRECOMPUTE_YIELD_MS.means: milliseconds a precompute pass yields to the writer

AKASHA_FEED_MIN_INTERVAL.means: seconds below which a feed is not pulled again (0 honours each feed's own interval)

AKASHA_TELEMETRY_KEEP_DAYS.means: days of telemetry kept (1 = today only)

AKASHA_REFERENCE_CACHE_TTL.means: seconds a rendered reference page stays fresh

AKASHA_RECIPE_FREE_QUOTA.means: own recipes a free plan may hold (0 = unmetered; above 0 the tiering is on)

AKASHA_RECIPE_PAID_FEATURES.means: analytics features that require a paid plan once a free quota is set

AKASHA_BRIDGE_PROVIDER.means: the translation provider of lex.bridge (wikidata | wikipedia)

AKASHA_LLM_MODEL.means: the model name the programmes speak with (provider and key are the platform's)

AKASHA_X_LINK.means: the link a programme's X post points back to
